newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Feb 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Feb 14.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Over 200 constituencies out of 577 may be arbitrated by the far-right party National Front in the upcoming general election, according to study by poll institutes' newsletter.
-- Airbus says Boeing seeks to prevent Airbus suppliers from taking part in project of a European competitor of Boeing's 747 aircraft.
-- Renault carmaker says 1996 losses to be higher than market estimates.
-- Merrill Lynch European equity strategist David Bowers says economic environment to remain favourable to French shares, notably in financial and services sectors.
-- Credit Immobilier de France says it may withdraw offer for Credit Foncier de France if the government has not reached a decision by the end of March.
